g.text: Adaptive routing fails the original performance gates
Figure 3 | Week 11 formal integration: 2,001 episodes; three contemporaneous arms
Fixed controls match all 667 binary outcomes and 16,500 identical-input action queries; full trajectories can differ with rendering.
Targeted bootstrap: 467 variants. Clean: 40 task clusters × 5 states. The clean interval reaches zero. These are reused panels, one training seed.
Latency includes every recorded rollout query, including first and failed queries. Engineering cost gates pass; performance gates fail.
